about: Known-good pairs of the 24A446 kernelcache's kernel imports: original (Apple's kernel) -> native symbol (ours), every import of kernel.kc's kexts that is bound. emit.py applies them over the matcher's and the inferred pairs (a reviewed record still wins where both name the same original and agree; audit.py fails the build where they disagree); audit.py checks each built kernel.kc against them. "leaf": the original only computes registers and returns, and any native function with the same instructions is right. why: both = the same pair in the Linux-built collection that booted to the Home Screen (2026-11-11) and the first Mac-built one (2026-11-12, eae11352); mac: = a pair only the Mac pairing made (how it was made, the instruction similarity against the reference kernel's function of that name), stubbed or unpaired in the Linux one; the others say what decided. Changing an entry needs the evidence in its why.
